lines.text: DeepL shows how to take one network link offline without slowing down everyone else.
Normally, each cloud region sends traffic out through its closest link to the data centers.
lines.title: Closest exit

lines.text: DeepL has three links, in Dublin, Copenhagen and Stockholm. Dublin needs maintenance.
lines.title: The problem

lines.text: DeepL makes the Dublin route look longer by adding extra steps, called an AS path prepend.
lines.title: The trick

lines.text: Only the Ireland region moves to another link. The other regions keep their own closest exit.
lines.title: Who moves

lines.text: The links stay up the whole time. The cost is extra data transfer fees during the detour.
lines.title: Takeaways
